WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes,
    COUNT(*) as total_observatories
  FROM telescope_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_telescopes as share,
    CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_telescopes - (1.0 / t.total_observatories) as difference
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  difference
FROM shares
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
